name: Underhanded Maneuver (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): Select one of the following combat maneuvers: dirty trick, disarm, sunder, steal, or trip. Whenever a rogue with this talent uses this combat maneuver against an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus against the rogue’s combat maneuver, flat-footed, or that the rogue is flanking when she makes her combat maneuver check, she uses her rogue level in place of her base attack bonus when calculating her CMB. The rogue can select this talent multiple times. Each time, she selects a different combat maneuver.
